EventView.description:
One record of the tenant's append-only stream, paged by `after_seq`.
`kind` is "<namespace>.<entity>.<action>", or an audit kind; the payload
stays inside, an event is a record and not a second read path. The rename
from `entity`/`entity_id`/`action` stayed under `/v1` (ADR 0006).
EventView.title: EventView

IdentityView.description: The person behind the caller's user; never carries the password hash.
IdentityView.title: IdentityView

IssuedLoginView.description: Carries the freshly minted login credential in the clear, once.
IssuedLoginView.title: IssuedLoginView

MoveTaskRequest.description: Places an open task right after `after_id`; null puts it at the top.
MoveTaskRequest.title: MoveTaskRequest

SessionView.description: Only the hash of a token is ever kept, so a session view carries no secret.
SessionView.title: SessionView

TaskPageView.description:
One page of a task list. `next_cursor` fetches the next page of the done
list; it is null on the last page and always for the open list.
TaskPageView.title: TaskPageView

TaskScope.description: Which tasks a list shows. The org is the team.
TaskScope.title: TaskScope

UpdateTaskRequest.description:
A partial update: absent fields are kept. An explicit null
`assignee_id` unassigns the task.
UpdateTaskRequest.title: UpdateTaskRequest
